meta.name: incoming-request-advisor
meta.description: Decode an incoming message into a structured breakdown that separates the literal ask from the job-to-be-done. Use before replying to a loaded Slack ping, email, mandate, or escalation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将模糊请求拆解为清晰任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常收到含糊的指令或紧急消息需要快速理清重点。
copy.tagline_en: Decode vague requests into clear tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive ambiguous instructions or urgent messages and need to quickly identify the core ask.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你粘贴的 Slack 消息、邮件等，拆解出字面请求和背后的真实需求，并评估发送者的权力和利益，最后给出分析报告和下一步建议。
howto.when: 当你收到一条需要回复的复杂消息（如 Slack 消息、邮件、指令或升级投诉），想在回复前先理清对方真正想要什么时触发。

say.text: 我的VP发来Slack说：“仪表盘重设计能进下个迭代吗？”帮我分析一下。
say.note: Claude 会拆解字面请求和背后需求，并给出回复建议。

say.text: 客户成功主管发来一封很长的投诉邮件，我不知道怎么回。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes a pasted message (Slack, email, etc.) to separate the literal ask from the underlying job-to-be-done, reads the sender's power and stake, and outputs a structured breakdown with recommended next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you receive a loaded message (Slack ping, email, mandate, escalation) and want to decode it before replying.

say_en.text: My VP Slacked: 'Can the dashboard redesign land next sprint?' Analyze this.
say_en.note: Claude will separate the ask from the job-to-be-done and suggest a reply.

say_en.text: I got a long escalation email from a frustrated customer-success lead and don't know how to respond.
say_en.note: Claude will extract the message, analyze sender intent, and offer reply options.
